scored_papers.title: Probability bounds on trajectory-level exceedances of quantum speed limits under continuous-measurement feedback
scored_papers.abstract: We investigate the probability that a conditioned quantum trajectory exceeds an ensemble-derived quantum speed limit (QSL) velocity under continuous measurement-based feedback. Using the finite-time average fidelity velocity, we derive an upper bound on the exceedance probability in terms of its mean and variance. We further obtain state-independent bounds from uniform constraints on the fidelity drift and diffusion, including an exponential concentration bound. For a feedback-controlled qubit, we derive explicit model-specific bounds and show that they are nontrivial in a short-time regime. We also identify a finite-time regime in which the exceedance probability vanishes exactly due to the restricted support of the conditioned dynamics. Monte Carlo simulations confirm the analytical bounds and illustrate their tightness.

scored_papers.summary: 有限時間平均の忠実度速度で、超過確率の上限を平均と分散から与え、指数的な集中不等式も導出。フィードバック制御 qubit で具体的な上限を示し、Monte Carlo で確認。
